stem.text: Reduction of compound R with $\text{LiAlH}_4$ gives the compound 4-methylpentane-2,3-diol.
What could be the identity of compound R?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: CH3-C(=O)-C(=O)-CH(CH3)2, with two adjacent C=O groups and an isopropyl end.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: CHO and C=O groups at one end of the chain, then CH2 and a CH bearing a methyl branch.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: CH3-C(=O)-CH(CH3)-C(=O)-CH3, with two C=O groups and a methyl branch on the central carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: CHO group, then CH bearing a methyl branch, then a C=O ketone, then an ethyl group.
